title: Multidimensional Rape Predisposition Scale
label: Dissertation · 2022
summary: This study aimed to develop and validate the Multidimensional Rape Predisposition Scale (MRPS) to assess the multifaceted nature of rape predisposition among young adults. A total of 165 participants (aged 17-38 years) completed the MRPS along with the Situational Rape Proclivity Scale (SRPS) and the Spiritual Transcendence Scale, Short Form (STS-R) (N=109) for convergent and discriminant validity assessment.

Exploratory factor analysis identified a five-factor model of the MRPS, comprising Affective Concern, Social Functioning, Need for Power, Responsibility Avoidance, and Consent Taking, accounting for 61.8% of the variance. The 17-item MRPS demonstrated good reliability with a Cronbach's alpha of .74.

Convergent validity was supported by a positive correlation between the MRPS and SRPS (r = .278, p < .01), while discriminant validity was evidenced by a non-significant, low correlation between the MRPS and STS-R (r = .038, p = .692).
